concept: Review and integration: a personal approach to clear thinking under real-world pressure
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across bias, source evaluation, and deciding under uncertainty — what's your personal throughline for thinking clearly?
exercise.practice: Adult writes a short personal statement on what wisdom means to them in practice

assessment.success_marker: adult produces a personal statement referencing at least two of the three adult-stage scenarios
